notes: Curation metadata and editorial search aliases do not modify the registry or past observations. Korean aliases are editorial transliterations for search, not a claim that the publisher uses those names.

Official web pages were reviewed on the stated date. Some XML and legacy bindings require the separately recorded bounded endpoint check; identity evidence must not be presented as a reachability check.
Whole-publisher scope means a publisher-wide selection, not a guarantee of every published article. Sections, language editions, regional coverage and unresolved national-major gaps are explicit.

The October 25 Chicago / October 26 UTC Japanese consumer trial added major-media selections and current publisher declaration evidence. Consumer tests do not replace saved production observations. Earlier US, Korean and supplemental Japanese evidence keeps its own original checked_at dates.

selection_criteria: Match exact current country, endpoint type and approved registry URL; curation never creates or reactivates a source.
Prioritize the requested major Japanese newsrooms, then retain explicitly labelled digital and regional supplements.
One entry per publisher brand; categories and alternate feed addresses must not inflate publisher counts.
Keep Japanese feeds distinct from English products, legacy host variants and distribution-platform streams.

Distinguish publisher declarations, dated consumer XML tests and saved authoritative collection evidence. A consumer success does not overwrite an Oracle failure.
These are bounded starter streams, not national-major completeness, neutrality ratings, full article access or republication rights.
